import json
prog = currentProgram
out = {"sha256": str(prog.getExecutableSHA256())}
fm = prog.getFunctionManager()
mem = prog.getMemory()
hits = {}
def scan(pattern, tag):
    try:
        start = mem.getMinAddress()
        addr = mem.findBytes(start, None, pattern, None, True, monitor)
        while addr is not None:
            monitor.checkCancelled()
            f = fm.getFunctionContaining(addr)
            fname = str(f.getName()) if f else ""
            faddr = str(f.getEntryPoint()) if f else ""
            off = addr.subtract(mem.getMinAddress())
            hits.setdefault(faddr, {}).setdefault(tag, []).append([str(addr), fname, str(off)])
            addr = mem.findBytes(addr.add(1), None, pattern, None, True, monitor)
    except Exception as e:
        out["err_"+tag] = str(e)
scan(bytes([0x9b,0x02,0x00,0x00]), "0x29b_disp32")
scan(bytes([0x9a,0x02,0x00,0x00]), "0x29a_disp32")
out["hits"] = hits
print(json.dumps(out))
